const j = $input.first().json || {};
return [{
  json: {
    status: j.status || (j.validate_status === 'error' ? 'error' : 'ok'),
    action: j.action || 'sync',
    storage_backend: j.storage_backend || 'github',
    output: j.output || 'MEMORY_AGENT: выполнено.',
    brain: j.brain || null,
    data: {
      total_files: j.total_files,
      total_bytes: j.total_bytes,
      matches: j.matches,
      archived_count: j.archived_count,
      compacted_count: j.compacted_count,
      memory_path: j.memory_path,
      stale_before_sync: j.stale_before_sync,
      missing: j.missing,
      brain_confidence: j.brain?.confidence,
      brain_priority: j.brain?.priority,
      brain_warnings: j.brain?.warnings || [],
    },
    results: j.results || [],
    archived: j.archived || [],
    compacted: j.compacted || [],
    connector_response: j.connector_response || null,
  },
}];
